summary: Iteration 22 — Full backend + frontend coverage for the five new features: Founding-artist fee waiver (settings, /waiver/me, re-register block, admin +30d/revoke, settings PATCH, settings_for_seller unit, reminder sweep idempotent), Flip Quotes (quote object with sketch/note/timeline, buyer accept flow), Trusted Devices (challenge → verify with remember_device → device_token skips 2FA, list/revoke/delete-all), Wallet Pass (image/png 1080x1920 attachment for /events/{id}/my-ticket/pass.png + /events/gift/{token}/pass.png + 404 unknown), i18n extension (es studio tab-overview 'Resumen', kicker 'Editor de estudio', /orders 'Tus pedidos', /messages 'Mensajes' + 'Buscar conversaciones...'). Regression pass: fee-preview net 92.8, demo login direct token, flip/artists 200, 2FA setup→enable→disable lifecycle. 14/14 pytest pass. Playwright UI flows all pass: founding banner + CTA on /, waiver-badge with correct countdown ('30 days left · 5 fee-free sales remaining') for a freshly registered artist, demo artist has no badge (0), admin Settings tab shows all three waiver inputs, Artists tab shows 34 waiver-extend-{id} buttons and clicking triggers post-extend toast, /security trusted-devices-card correctly only renders when 2FA is enabled (verified conditional in code), /tickets ticket-qr-modal + wallet-pass-btn present and Playwright expect_download successfully saves artcore-ticket.png (58KB) without JS errors, EventDetail show-ticket-btn → wallet-pass-btn visible. Language round-trip en→es→en works.
critical_code_review_comments: waiver.grant_waiver blocks re-grant on same email if source='signup' in waiver_grants — correct, but note db.users.delete_one during tests must NOT drop waiver_grants (verified). Consider a boolean flag on the user record for cleaner auditability.
waiver.waiver_status computes days_left with `.days + (1 if seconds > 0 else 0)` — rounds up to at least 1 when within the same day; slight over-count if until is < 60s away but harmless UX.

twofa.is_trusted_device compares hash via hmac.compare_digest but the second .get('expires_at','') > now uses lexicographic string compare on ISO datetimes — safe because ISO-8601 with tz suffix is lexicographically monotonic when timezones match; both sides use UTC isoformat() so OK.
twofa.verify_login stores raw device_token only as its sha256 hash (good). expiry 30 days stored per-device; $slice: -10 caps the trusted-devices list — reasonable.

events.my_ticket_pass returns 404 when either event or rsvp missing, but does not check event ownership beyond rsvp existence — fine because rsvp is scoped to (event_id, user_id). Cache-Control: private, max-age=3600 is appropriate.
wallet_pass.render_pass builds a 1080x1920 PIL image on the request thread — CPU-bound sync work inside async endpoint. At current scale fine; consider run_in_executor for high concurrency.

commissions.respond stores 'quote' only on counter action but doesn't validate that timeline_days/sketch_image are only sent for flip commissions; harmless (extra fields ignored downstream for 'art' kind since the frontend gates the UI).
auth.login uses lowercase email consistently. LoginReq.device_token max_length=200 — plenty for a token_urlsafe(32) which is ~43 chars.
admin_settings PATCH accepts waiver_days/waiver_enabled/waiver_max_sales — verified round-trip. Consider log entry on any settings change for audit.
